caption:
Price broke above value. Then got REJECTED. 📊

A break above the value area high is a question, not an answer. If the market accepts higher prices you see time and volume build up there. If the next 30-minute period closes back inside value, nobody wanted those prices: it's a failed auction, and price tends to rotate back to the POC and often the other side of value.

1️⃣ Price breaks above the value area high
2️⃣ Back inside value with no volume built above = failed auction
3️⃣ Target the POC first, invalidate above the failed high
